title: GTA 6 Age Rating Reveals Lucia and Jason Can Use Drugs Anytime
description: A new age rating for GTA 6 reveals that protagonists Lucia and Jason can frequently and prominently partake in drug use directly from their inventory.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Age Rating Details Lucia and Jason's Inventory-Based Drug Use

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world epic, new details regarding the game's adult content have surfaced through recent age-rating documentation. According to a report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, GTA 6 is set to expand its vast array of mature pastimes with a notable new mechanic.

### Expanding the Series' Mature Content

The Grand Theft Auto franchise has always embraced a notorious reputation for letting players engage in chaotic and illicit activities. From bustling strip clubs and violent car-jackings to carefree rampages, the series has never shied away from its M-for-Mature roots. 

However, a fresh age rating indicates that the next installment will feature "frequent and prominent" drug use, adding yet another layer to the chaotic sandbox experience players have come to expect.

### Direct Access From the Inventory

What sets this apart from previous iterations is the level of accessibility described in the rating. Players controlling protagonists Lucia and Jason will reportedly be able to partake in these activities "directly from their inventory" and do so "at any time" during the game.

This integration of substance use directly into the player's inventory system suggests a deeper level of character management or immersive role-playing mechanics within the vast open world of Vice City and its surrounding areas.

### Editor's Take

This latest age-rating revelation shows that Rockstar Games is doubling down on the gritty, unfiltered realism that defines the franchise. Allowing players to manage and consume substances directly from their inventory at any moment raises the bar for in-game simulation and player agency, ensuring that GTA 6 will continue to push boundaries when it launches.
